messages:
Jordan H: Heads up — we flipped on ephemeral-SA enforcement for the gpu-run-1 namespace as part of the least-priv rollout. Seeing intermittent KMS decrypt denies that are blocking some deploys. Anyone around to triage?

Liam K: I'm online, pasting the latest deploy log when it shows up. Do you have the audit ID?

SecurityBot: [ALERT] KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/deploy/cryptoKeys/deploy-key principal=system:serviceaccount:gpu-run-1:ephemeral-deployer-7f4a project_id=redwood ts=2163456720

Jordan H: pasted above. Example from deploy job: 
```
Error: KMS permission denied: iam.kms.decrypt for key projects/redwood/.../deploy-key
at cloudkms.Client.Decrypt(...)
```

DevOpsBot: CI job #7821 shows HTTP 403 from kms service during artifact unlock step.

Anya R: Likely cause: during the RBAC refactor we moved deployer bindings to project-scoped roles and removed a legacy key-specific binding. Ephemeral SA flow impersonates deployer-SA, but the impersonated principal lost kms:Decrypt on that cryptoKey.

Liam K: can you run a quick check? `kubectl -n gpu-run-1 get rolebinding -o yaml` and `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy deploy-key` (or equivalent).

Jordan H: ran both, snippet: 
```
# rolebinding in namespace
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: ephemeral-deployer-7f4a
  namespace: gpu-run-1
roleRef:
  name: ns-deployer-lite
# kms IAM policy for deploy-key: only has roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter binding to group:deploy-service-accounts@redwood
```

Anya R: there it is. The namespace SA is bound to ns-deployer-lite which intentionally removed project-level key bindings. The deploy path relied on a higher-level role (deploy-service-account) to have key permissions — that breaking change wasn't carried over for the ephemeral token path.

Priya S: immediate mitigation: revert the RBAC change for ephemeral impersonation path or add a key-specific binding scoped to the deploy-key for the impersonation principal. Which is faster?

Jordan H: reverted the rollout for the namespace (rolled back to previous rolebinding) — deploys resumed.

Anya R: I'll open a safe fix: reintroduce a narrowly-scoped binding granting only decrypt for that cryptoKey to the impersonation principal (not wildcard project perms). Also adding an e2e that acquires an ephemeral token and runs a small KMS decrypt to catch regressions. PR: https://github.com/redwood-infra/policies/pull/4321

Priya S: please add a Datadog monitor for `kms.decrypt.failures` + `tag:namespace:gpu-run-1` and an alert for >3 failures in 5m. Also add an audit-log-based rule that correlates KMS_DENY with ephemeral SA subjects.

SecurityBot: runbook link: <https://redwood-infra/internal/runbooks/kms-ephemeral-sa> — steps for revoke, rollback, and permanent fix.

Liam K: triage note for incident timeline: 2163456720 first KMS deny (9 fails total), rollback at 2163457005, full recovery at 2163457120. Will add to postmortem.

Jordan H: thanks all. Action items: Anya PR for key-scoped binding + e2e, Priya monitor + audit rule, Liam add timeline to postmortem. I'll follow up on documentation for ephemeral SA migration path. :thumbsup:
